words.en: Located on the side of the body that is toward the east when one is facing north.

words.ex: Who is that girl?
words.en: You use who in questions to ask about the name, identity, or function of one or more people.

words.ex: The woman is walking her dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个女人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A woman is an adult female human being.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.ex: The book is next to the pen.
words.en: Adjacent to; at the side of.

words.ex: Her husband cooks dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 她的丈夫每天晚上做晚饭。
words.en: A married man considered in relation to his spouse.

words.tr:
n. 前面；前线；
adj. 前面的；
words.ex: The front of the house has a big garden.
words.ex_cn: 房子的前面有一个大花园。
words.en: The front is the part of something that faces forward or is the most important or prominent part.

words.ex: The cat is sitting in front of the house.
words.en: If someone or something is in front of a particular thing, they are facing it, ahead of it, or close to the front part of it.

words.tr: pron. 那些；“that”的复数； adj. 那些的；
words.ex: Those books are on the table.
words.en: You use those to refer to people or things which have already been mentioned or which are already known about.

words.ex: I take the bus to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天乘公共汽车去学校。
words.en: A bus is a large motor vehicle which carries passengers from one place to another.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.ex: He went to the hospital because he felt sick.
words.ex_cn: 他因为感觉不舒服去了医院。
words.en: A hospital is a place where people who are ill or injured are treated and taken care of by doctors and nurses.

words.ex: We stayed at a small hotel near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在海边一家小旅馆里。
words.en: A hotel is a building where people stay, for example on holiday, paying for their rooms and meals.

words.tr:
n. 警方；警察部门；
v. 监督；
words.ex: The police caught the thief last night.
words.en: The police are the official organization that is responsible for making sure that people obey the law, for catching criminals, and for keeping public order.

words.ex: We watched a play at the theatre last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在剧场看了一场戏。
words.en: A theatre is a building with a stage in it, on which plays, shows, and other performances take place.

words.ex: He is an actor in a famous movie.
words.ex_cn: 他是电影中的一名演员。
words.en: An actor is a person whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: The driver stopped the car at the red light.
words.en: A driver is a person who drives a vehicle.

words.ex: The manager approved the new project.
words.en: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

words.ex: The nurse gave the patient medicine.
words.en: A nurse is a person whose job is to care for people who are ill or injured, especially in a hospital.

words.ex: The policeman stopped the car.
words.en: A policeman is a man who is a member of the police force.

words.ex: The policemen stopped the car.
words.en: Policemen are members of the police force who are responsible for maintaining public order, preventing and detecting crime.

words.ex: We are eating lunch now.
words.en: We is the first person plural pronoun used by a speaker or writer to refer to themselves and one or more other people considered together.

words.tr: art. 一个 （在下一单词为元音开头时代替“a”）
words.ex: I saw an apple on the table.
words.ex_cn: 我看到桌子上有一个苹果。
words.en: Used before a word that begins with a vowel sound.

words.ex: He got a new job last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周找到了一份新工作。
words.en: A job is the work that someone does regularly in order to earn money.

words.ex: He threw the ball at the window.
words.en: You use at to indicate the place or event where something happens or is situated.

words.ex: He has the same book as me.
words.ex_cn: 他有一本和我一样的书。
words.en: If two or more things, actions, or qualities are the same, or if one is the same as another, they are very like each other in some way.

words.ex: The doctor helped the sick child.
words.ex_cn: 医生帮助了生病的孩子。
words.en: A doctor is someone who is qualified in medicine and treats people who are ill.

words.tr:
n. 农场；农庄；
v. 耕种；
words.ex: He works on a small farm with cows and chickens.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个养牛和鸡的小农场工作。
words.en: A farm is an area of land, together with the buildings on it, that is used for growing crops or raising animals.

words.ex: The worker fixed the machine quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这位工作者迅速修好了机器。
words.en: A worker is a person who does a particular job to earn money.

words.tr:
n. 男人；人；
v. 操作；
words.ex: The man is walking his dog in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个男人正在公园里遛狗。
words.en: A man is an adult human male.

words.ex: The men are working in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这些男人正在花园里干活。
words.en: Men are adult human males. The term is used to distinguish them from women or boys.

words.tr:
n. 商店；
v. 购物；
words.ex: I bought bread from the local shop.
words.ex_cn: 我从附近的商店买了面包。
words.en: A shop is a place where goods are sold; also, to shop means to visit shops in order to buy things.

words.ex: Its color is blue.
words.en: Belonging to or associated with a thing previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr: pron. 他们的；她们的；它们的；
words.ex: Their books are on the table.
words.en: You use their to indicate that something belongs or relates to the group of people, animals, or things that you are talking about.

words.ex: The book is in the bag.
words.en: Used to indicate location or position within something.

words.tr:
n. 英语；英文；
adj. 英格兰的；英格兰人的；英语的；
words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.en: English refers to the language spoken in Britain, the United States, and many other parts of the world, as well as to the people of England.

words.tr: phrase. 用英语；在英语方面
words.ex: Can you say it in english?
words.en: In the language that originated in England and is now used in many countries.

words.ex: This is a good example of teamwork.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个团队合作的好例子。
words.en: An example is a particular instance of something that is representative of a group or used to illustrate a point.

words.ex: He writes a letter every day.
words.en: To write means to form letters, words, or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

words.ex: He is on the bus.
words.en: used to indicate position above and in contact with a surface, or to indicate the topic of discussion, or to indicate the time when something happens, or to indicate the means by which something is done, or to indicate the basis for something, or to indicate the state of something

words.ex: This is the book I bought.
words.ex_cn: 这是我自己买的那本书。
words.en: used to refer to a specific person or thing that has already been mentioned or is known about

words.ex: The teacher writes on the blackboard.
words.en: A blackboard is a dark-colored board that you can write on with chalk, used especially in classrooms.

words.tr:
adj. 好的；不错的；可以的
int. 好的；可以
words.ex: The food is OK.
words.en: An expression meaning 'all right' or 'acceptable', used to indicate approval or agreement.

words.ex: He writes with a black pen.
words.ex_cn: 他用一支黑色钢笔写字。
words.en: A pen is a tool used for writing or drawing with ink.

words.tr:
adj. 没有；不
adv. 不；不是
words.ex: There is no water in the bottle.
words.en: used to give a negative response or statement

words.ex: He uses a pencil to write his name.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔写自己的名字。
words.en: A pencil is an instrument that you use for writing or drawing, consisting of a thin stick of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle.

words.ex: I do my homework every evening.
words.en: To perform or accomplish something

words.ex: The bird flies over the tree.
words.en: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs, and most birds can fly.

words.ex: The cat sleeps on the sofa.
words.en: A cat is a small furry animal with a tail, whiskers, and sharp claws. Cats are often kept as pets.

words.ex: The dog barks loudly at night.
words.en: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt.

words.ex: The garden is full of bright flowers.
words.ex_cn: 花园里开满了鲜艳的花。
words.en: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly colored, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

words.tr:
v. 帮助；
n. 帮助；
words.ex: He helps his sister with her homework.
words.en: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or information.

words.ex: He gave the book to me.
words.en: Me is the object pronoun used to refer to oneself as the object of a verb or preposition.

words.ex: He talked of his trip to Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他谈论了他去巴黎的旅行。
words.en: You use of to combine two nouns when the first noun identifies the feature of the second noun that you want to talk about.

words.ex: The course of the river changed after the flood.
words.ex_cn: 河流的流程在洪水后发生了变化。
words.en: A course is a series of lessons or lectures on a particular subject.

words.ex: Of course, I will help you with your homework.
words.en: Used to express agreement or to indicate that something is expected or obvious.

words.ex: The students are sitting in the classroom.
words.en: A room in a school where lessons take place.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.ex: He says hello every morning.
words.en: To express in words; to state or declare.

words.tr:
conj. 那（引导从句）；
pron. 那儿；那里；
adj. 那；那个；那样的；
adv. 那个；那么；那样；
words.ex: I know that he is coming tomorrow.
words.en: Used to identify a specific person or thing observed or heard by the speaker.

words.ex: He called me again yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天又给我打了电话。
words.en: Once more; another time.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.tr: phrase. 不客气；不用谢（用于回应别人的感谢）
words.ex: You're welcome.
words.en: A polite response used to acknowledge thanks or as a standalone greeting.

words.tr:
adj. 黑色的；
n. 黑色；
words.ex: He wore a black shirt to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了一件黑色的衬衫去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is black is of the darkest colour that there is, the colour of the sky at night when there is no light at all.

words.tr:
adj. 白色的；
n. 白色；
words.ex: The white cat sat on the windowsill.
words.en: White is the lightest color and is achromatic (having no hue), because it fully reflects and scatters all the visible wavelengths of light.

words.tr:
adj. 蓝色的；
n. 蓝色；
words.ex: The sky is blue today.
words.en: Blue is a color that is between green and violet in the spectrum of visible light. It is also used to describe something that is sad or depressed.

words.tr:
adj. 绿色的；未熟的；无经验的；
n. 绿色；
words.ex: The leaves are green in spring.
words.en: Green is the color between blue and yellow in the spectrum. It is the color of growing grass and leaves.

words.tr:
adj. 黄色的；
n. 黄色；
words.ex: The banana is yellow.
words.en: Yellow is the color of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg. It is one of the three primary colors.

words.tr:
adj. 红的；
n. 红色；
words.ex: The apple is red.
words.en: Red is the colour of blood or of ripe tomatoes.

words.tr:
adj. 褐色的；棕色的；
n. 褐色；棕色；
words.ex: The brown dog slept on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 那只褐色的狗躺在地板上睡觉。
words.en: Brown is a color that is a mixture of red, yellow, and black. It is the color of earth, wood, and many other natural things.

words.tr:
n. 橙子；橙色；
adj. 橙色的；
words.ex: I ate an orange for breakfast.
words.en: A round juicy citrus fruit with a tough bright reddish-yellow rind.

words.tr:
n. 颜色；
v. 着色；

words.en: Colour is the appearance that things have that results from the way in which they reflect light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

words.ex: I like apples and oranges.
words.en: Used to connect words of the same part of speech, clauses, or sentences, that are to be taken jointly.

words.ex: He uses a computer to do his homework.
words.en: A computer is an electronic machine that can store and deal with large amounts of information.

words.ex: The room has new furniture.
words.en: Furniture refers to the movable objects intended to support various human activities such as seating, eating, and sleeping.

words.ex: He uses a map to find the way.
words.en: A map is a visual representation of an area, showing physical features, cities, roads, etc., typically on a flat surface.

words.tr:
n. 图画；照片；
v. 想象；
words.ex: The child drew a picture of a cat.
words.ex_cn: 孩子画了一幅猫的图画。
words.en: A picture is a visual representation of something, such as a photograph, drawing, or painting. It can also refer to a movie or a description that creates a mental image.

words.tr: n. 电视节目；电视行业；电视机；
words.ex: He watches television every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上看电视节目。
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: He watches tv every evening.
words.en: A system for transmitting visual images and sound that are reproduced on screens, chiefly used to broadcast programs for entertainment, information, and education.

words.ex: He paints the wall blue.
words.en: A wall is a vertical structure, often made of stone or brick, that divides or encloses an area of land.

words.ex: He has thirty books in his bag.
words.en: The number 30.

words.ex: He has forty books on his shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他的书架上有四十本书。
words.en: The number 40.

words.ex: He has fifty dollars in his pocket.
words.en: The number equivalent to the product of five and ten; ten more than forty; 50.

words.ex: He has sixty apples in his basket.
words.ex_cn: 他的篮子里有六十个苹果。
words.en: The number 60.

words.ex: He is seventy years old.
words.en: The number 70.

words.ex: He is eighty years old.
words.en: The number 80.

words.ex: He is ninety years old.
words.en: the number 90

words.ex: He really loves his job.
words.ex_cn: 他真正地热爱他的工作。
words.en: You use really to emphasize that something is true or that it is the case.

words.tr:
adj. 许多的；
pron. 许多人或物；
words.ex: Many students like to play soccer after school.
words.ex_cn: 许多学生喜欢放学后踢足球。
words.en: A large number of.

words.ex: How many apples do you have?
words.en: used to ask about the number of something

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.en: A lot refers to a large number or amount of something. It can also mean a piece of land or someone's fate or destiny.

words.ex: He has a lot of books.
words.en: A large number or amount of something.

words.ex: Oh, I didn't know that.
words.en: used to express surprise, fear, joy, etc.

words.tr:
adj. 任何的；
pron. 任何；
adv. 稍微；
words.ex: You can choose any book from the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 你可以从书架上选任何一本书。
words.en: You use any to refer to one or some of a thing or number of things, no matter how much or how many.

words.ex: He loves the world and wants to travel everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱这个世界，想要去所有地方旅行。
words.en: The earth, together with all of its countries, peoples, and natural features.

words.ex: The tree grows near the house.
words.en: A tree is a tall plant with a trunk and branches made of wood.

words.tr: n. 建筑物；楼房； v. 建筑；“build”的现在分词；

words.en: A building is a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place.

words.ex: The students gathered in the hall for the assembly.
words.en: A hall is a large room or building which is used for public events such as concerts, exhibitions, and meetings.

words.ex: We eat lunch in the dining hall.
words.en: A dining hall is a large room in a institution where meals are served to a large number of people.

words.ex: He closed the gate before it rained.
words.en: A gate is a structure like a door which is used at the entrance to a field, a garden, or the grounds of a building.

words.ex: He goes to the library every afternoon.
words.en: A library is a building where books, documents, CDs, and sometimes videos and music are kept for people to read, study, or borrow.

words.ex: He works in an office downtown.
words.ex_cn: 他在市中心的一间办公室工作。
words.en: An office is a room or set of rooms where people work, especially in a business or organization.

words.ex: The children are playing on the playground.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在游乐场上玩耍。
words.en: A playground is an area designed for children to play in, especially at a school or in a park.

words.ex: He loves science and reads books about it.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢科学，经常读关于它的书。
words.en: Science is the study of the nature and behaviour of natural things and the knowledge that we obtain about them.

words.ex: The students do experiments in the lab.
words.ex_cn: 学生们在实验室做实验。
words.en: A lab is a place where scientific experiments and research are conducted.

words.ex: He works in a laboratory on Fridays.
words.ex_cn: 他在星期五去实验室工作。
words.en: A laboratory is a place equipped for scientific research, experiments, or teaching.

words.tr:
prep. 在…后面；
adv. 在后面；

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.tr:
n. 中间；
adj. 中间的；
words.ex: The ball stopped in the middle of the field.
words.en: The middle of something is the part of it that is equally distant from its edges or outer limits.

words.tr:
prep. 靠近；在…附近；

words.en: If something is near, it is not far away in distance or time.

words.ex: She went to the park with her friend.
words.ex_cn: 她和她的朋友去了公园。
words.en: used to indicate accompaniment, association, or relationship

words.tr:
prep. 为；因为；给；
conj. 因为；由于；
words.ex: I bought this gift for my mother.
words.ex_cn: 我为我妈妈买了这份礼物。

words.ex_cn: 这个房间有一张床和一扇窗户。
words.en: A room is a part of the inside of a building that is separated from other parts by walls, floor, and ceiling.

words.ex: I will see you tomorrow day.
words.en: A day is a period of twenty-four hours, especially from twelve o'clock one night to twelve o'clock the next night.

words.tr:

n. 今天；当今；

words.ex_cn: 我今天会完成我的作业。
words.en: This day, as distinct from yesterday or tomorrow.

words.en: Tuesday is the day of the week following Monday and preceding Wednesday.

words.ex_cn: 我在星期三有一个会议。
words.en: Wednesday is the day of the week that comes after Tuesday and before Thursday.

words.ex: I have a meeting on Thursday.
words.en: Thursday is the day of the week between Wednesday and Friday.

words.ex: I will go to the park on Friday.
words.en: Friday is the day of the week between Thursday and Saturday.

words.ex: We go to the park on Saturday.
words.en: Saturday is the day of the week that comes after Friday and before Sunday.

words.ex: We go to the park on Sunday.
words.en: Sunday is the day of the week following Saturday and preceding Monday.

words.ex: He is having a birthday party tomorrow.
words.en: Your birthday is the anniversary of the date on which you were born.

words.tr:
adj. 特别受喜爱的；
n. 特别喜爱的事物；
words.ex: Chocolate is my favourite dessert.
words.ex_cn: 巧克力是我最喜爱的甜点。
words.en: Something or someone that is preferred above all others.

words.tr:
n. 春天；弹簧；泉；
v. 突然猛烈地移动；跳；
words.ex: Flowers bloom in spring.
words.en: Spring is the season between winter and summer when plants begin to grow again. It is also a device that returns to its original shape after being compressed or stretched, or a natural source of water.

words.ex: I love swimming in the sea during summer.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在夏天去海里游泳。
words.en: Summer is the season between spring and autumn when the weather is usually warm or hot.

words.ex: Leaves fall in autumn.
words.en: Autumn is the season between summer and winter when leaves change color and the weather becomes cooler.

words.ex: The birds fly south in winter.
words.en: Winter is the season between autumn and spring. In the winter, the weather is usually cold.

words.tr:
adj. 温暖的；
v. （使）变暖；
words.ex: The sun gives us warm light.
words.en: Having or giving out a moderate degree of heat, as perceived by the senses.

words.ex: The soup is hot.
words.en: Having a high degree of heat or a high temperature.

words.tr:
adj. 凉爽的；酷的；凉的；顶好的；
v. 变凉；
words.ex: The water is cool after the rain.

words.tr:

n. 寒冷；

words.ex: He plays football with his friends every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友踢足球。
words.en: A game played by two teams of eleven players with a round ball that may not be touched with the hands or arms during play except by the goalkeepers. The object of the game is to score goals by kicking or heading the ball into the opponents' goal.

words.en: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal that has already been mentioned or is easily identified.

words.ex: I want a cup of tea.
words.en: If you want something, you feel a desire or a need for it.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: She cooks dinner in the kitchen.
words.en: A kitchen is a room or part of a room used for cooking and food preparation in a dwelling or in a commercial establishment.

words.ex: The farmer grows wheat on his land.
words.ex_cn: 这位农场主在他的土地上种植小麦。
words.en: A farmer is a person who owns or manages a farm.

words.ex: I will see you next week.
words.en: A week is a period of seven days.

words.ex: I read a book every night.
words.en: To look at and comprehend the meaning of written or printed matter by interpreting the characters or symbols of which it is composed.

words.tr: n. 故事；小说；轶事；假话；
words.ex: He told a funny story to his children.
words.ex_cn: 他给孩子们讲了一个有趣的故事。
words.en: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

words.tr:
v. 生活；居住；活着；
adj. 活的；现场的；实况转播的；
words.ex: They live in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: To live means to be alive, to have your home in a particular place, or to spend your life in a particular way.

words.tr:
n. 熊；
v. 承受；忍受；带有；生（孩子）；
words.ex: A bear walked near the campsite.
words.ex_cn: 一只熊在露营地附近走动。
words.en: If you bear something, you accept it and are able to deal with it, even though it is unpleasant or painful. A bear is a large, strong wild animal with thick fur and sharp claws.

words.ex: The elephant walks slowly in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 大象在动物园里慢慢走。
words.en: An elephant is a very large animal with a long trunk, large ears, and two long curved tusks. Elephants are found in Africa and Asia.

words.ex: The giraffe eats leaves from tall trees.
words.ex_cn: 长颈鹿吃高树上的叶子。
words.en: A giraffe is a large African animal with a very long neck and legs and pale brown fur with dark spots. Giraffes are the tallest living land animals.

words.ex: The lion roars loudly in the wild.
words.en: A lion is a large wild animal of the cat family, which is found in Africa. Lions have yellowish fur, and male lions have a mane.

words.ex: The monkey is eating a banana.
words.en: A monkey is a small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail, most kinds of which live in trees in tropical countries.

words.ex: The panda is eating bamboo in the zoo.
words.ex_cn: 这只熊猫在动物园里吃竹子。
words.en: A panda is a large, black-and-white bear-like mammal native to China, known for its distinctive markings and diet consisting almost entirely of bamboo.

words.ex: The tiger walks quietly in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 老虎在森林里静静地行走。
words.en: A tiger is a large wild animal that has a yellow and black striped coat and is a member of the cat family.

words.ex: The zebra runs fast in the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 斑马在草原上跑得很快。
words.en: A zebra is an African wild horse with black-and-white stripes.

words.ex: We visited the zoo to see the lions.
words.en: A place where live animals are kept so that people can go to look at them.

words.tr:
n. 导游；指南；向导；
v. 指导；指引；
words.ex: The guide showed us the ancient temple.
words.ex_cn: 导游带我们参观了这座古庙。
words.en: A guide is someone who shows other people the way to a place in a difficult or unknown region. A guide is also a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

words.ex: The animal is sleeping in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这只动物正在森林里睡觉。
words.en: An animal is a living creature such as a dog, lion, or rabbit, rather than a plant, insect, bird, or fish.

words.tr:
adj. 这样的；如此的；
pron. 这样的人或事；
words.ex: He made such a big mistake.
words.en: You use such to refer back to the thing or person that you have just mentioned, or a thing or person like the one that you have just mentioned. You use such as and such...as to introduce examples of the thing or person that you have just mentioned.

words.tr:
adv. 如同；和…一样
prep. 作为；如同
conj. 由于；像；当…时；尽管
words.ex: He runs as fast as a cheetah.
words.en: used to compare two things, to show that they are similar in some way; used to introduce the reason for something; used to mean 'in the role of'

words.ex: He likes fruits such as apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果和香蕉这样的水果。
words.en: Used to introduce examples of something that has been mentioned.

words.ex: Please come to my house tomorrow.
words.en: To move or travel towards the speaker or with the speaker; to arrive at a place; to happen or take place.

words.ex: He comes from a small village.
words.en: To originate or hail from a particular place or background.

words.ex: The two apples are different.
words.en: not the same as another or each other; unlike in nature, form, or quality

words.ex: He loves his country and wants to serve it.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱自己的国家，想要为它服务。
words.en: A country is a region identified as a distinct entity in political geography.

words.tr:
adj. 其他的；
pron. 其他（人或物）；
words.ex: I have two books; one is mine, and the other is my friend's.
words.ex_cn: 我有两本书，一本是我的，另一本是我朋友的。
words.en: Used to refer to a person or thing that is different or distinct from one already mentioned or known about.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: I said ugh when I saw the math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我看到数学作业时说了声‘哼’。
words.en: Used to express disgust, horror, or other strong negative feelings.

words.ex: I like apples, and I also like oranges.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢苹果，我也喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use also to give more information about something or to add another relevant fact.

words.tr:
n. 植物；工厂；发电厂；装置；
v. 种植；栽培；
words.ex: The plant grows near the window.
words.en: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots. As a verb, to plant means to put a seed or plant into the ground so that it will grow.

words.tr:
v. 看；看上去；
n. 看；
words.ex: He looks at the sky.
words.en: To direct your eyes in a particular direction.

words.ex: He looks at the picture carefully.
words.en: To direct your eyes towards someone or something so that you can see them.

words.ex: He is a tall man.
words.en: If something is tall, it is higher than usual or than other things of its type.

words.tr:
adj. 确信；必定的；
adv. 当然；当然可以；
words.ex: I am sure he will come tomorrow.
words.en: If you are sure that something is true, you are certain that it is true. If you say that something is sure to happen, you mean that it will definitely happen.

words.ex: He made a basket from bamboo.
words.ex_cn: 他用竹子做了一个篮子。
words.en: Bamboo is a tall tropical plant with hard, hollow stems. The young shoots of the plant can be eaten and the stems are used to make furniture.

words.ex: The puppy is cute.
words.en: If you describe someone or something as cute, you mean that they are attractive, often in a childlike or youthful way.

words.ex: I shall go to the park tomorrow.
words.en: used to indicate future action or intention, or to express obligation or necessity

words.tr: pron. 它们（宾格）；他们；她们；
words.ex: I saw them in the park.
words.ex_cn: 我在公园里看到了它们。
words.en: Used as the object of a verb or preposition to refer to people or things previously mentioned or easily identified.

words.tr:
pron. 哪个；
adj. 哪个的；
words.ex: Which book do you want to read?
words.en: You use which in questions when there are two or more possible answers or alternatives.

words.tr:
prep. 遍于…之上；越过；
adv. 大于；结束；越过；
words.ex: The blanket is over the bed.
words.en: In addition to the meanings related to physical position or movement above something, 'over' can also indicate completion, excess, or repetition.

words.ex: There is a book on the table.
words.en: Used to indicate the place where someone or something is or where something happens.

words.ex: The ball is over there.
words.en: In or to that place; at a distance.

words.tr: adj. 滑稽的；好笑的；有趣的；
words.ex: The funny clown made everyone laugh.
words.ex_cn: 那个滑稽的小丑让所有人都笑了。
words.en: Something that is funny is amusing and likely to make you laugh.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.ex: He wants to visit Africa next year.
words.en: Africa is the continent south of Europe, between the Atlantic Ocean and the Indian Ocean.

words.ex: He travels to Asia every summer.
words.ex_cn: 他每年夏天都去亚洲旅行。
words.en: Asia is the largest of the world's continents, covering approximately 30 percent of the Earth's land area. It is also the world's most populous continent, with roughly 60 percent of the total population.

words.ex: He traveled to Europe last summer.
words.en: Europe is one of the world's seven continents, comprising the westernmost peninsula of Eurasia. It's known for its rich history, diverse cultures, and significant contributions to art, science, and politics.

words.ex: There is little water left in the bottle.
words.en: Small in size, amount, or degree (often used to convey an appealing diminutiveness or express an affectionate or dismissive attitude).

words.ex: He has a little money left.
words.en: A small amount of something.

words.tr:
adv. 只；仅仅；只有；
adj. 唯一的；仅有的；
words.ex: He eats only apples for breakfast.
words.en: You use only to indicate the one thing that is true, appropriate, or important in a particular situation, in contrast to all the other things that are not true, appropriate, or important.

words.tr:
prep. 关于；大约；大概；涉及；
adv. 大约；到处；
words.ex: The book is about animals.
words.en: If you talk about something, you are discussing it or mentioning it. If you do something about a problem, you take action to solve it.

words.ex: He bought two kilos of apples.
words.en: A kilo is a unit of measurement equal to 1,000 grams or approximately 2.2 pounds. It is commonly used to measure weight.

words.ex: The apple weighs one kilogram.
words.en: A kilogram is a unit of mass equal to one thousand grams.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: There are 38 people in the classroom.
words.en: People are men, women, and children. People is often used to refer to a large group of people, especially when their exact number is not known or not important.

words.ex: People all over the world like chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 全世界的人都喜欢巧克力。
words.en: everywhere in the world

words.tr:
adj. 非洲的；非洲人的；
n. 非洲人；
words.ex: He loves African music and dance.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢非洲的音乐和舞蹈。
words.en: Relating to Africa or its people, culture, or languages.

words.ex: The green leaf fell from the tree.
words.en: A leaf is one of the flat, usually green parts of a plant that are joined to its stem or branches.

words.ex: The children play on the grass after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草地上玩耍。
words.en: Grass is a very common plant consisting of large numbers of thin, spiky, green leaves that cover the surface of the ground.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.ex: She usually walks to school.
words.en: Under normal conditions; generally.

words.tr:
adv. 单独；独自；
adj. 独自的；孤独的；
words.ex: He walked alone in the park.
words.en: If you are alone, you are not with any other people.

words.ex: He is good at math.
words.en: To have a natural ability or skill in a particular area.

words.ex: He is strong enough to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他很强壮，足以举起这个箱子。
words.en: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；赶上；理解；得病；接住；
n. 接住；搭扣；
words.ex: He tried to catch the ball.
words.en: If you catch something or someone, you manage to get hold of them or stop them from moving, often after a chase or search.

words.tr: phrase. 许多种类的；各种各样的
words.ex: There are many kinds of fruits in the market.
words.ex_cn: 市场上有很多种类的水果。
words.en: A variety of different types or categories.

words.tr:
adv. 甚至；甚至于；
adj. 平坦的；
words.ex: He didn't even say goodbye.
words.en: Even is used to emphasize something that is surprising or unlikely. It can also describe something that is flat, smooth, or level, or something that is equal in amount, degree, or value.

words.ex: He types fast on the keyboard.
words.ex_cn: 他打字很快，用的是键盘。
words.en: A keyboard is a panel of keys that operate a computer or typewriter.

words.ex: The mouse ran under the table.
words.en: A mouse is a small animal with a long tail, which is found in houses and fields and is often kept as a pet. In computing, a mouse is a small device that you move across a surface in order to move a cursor on your computer screen.

words.ex: The cats chased the mice in the kitchen.
words.en: Mice are small rodents that are typically characterized by a pointed snout, small rounded ears, a body-length scaly tail, and a high breeding rate.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: The bridge connects the two cities.
words.ex_cn: 这座桥连接了两座城市。
words.en: If something or someone connects one thing to another, or if one thing connects to another, the two things are joined together.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.tr: phrase. 开启；接通；发动；突击
words.ex: He turns on the light in the room.
words.en: To cause something to start operating, especially by pressing a switch or button.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.tr:
v. 节省；拯救；保存；
prep. 除...之外；除了；
words.ex: He saves money by walking to work.
words.ex_cn: 他通过步行上班来节省钱。
words.en: To save something means to keep it from being lost or damaged; to save money or time is to avoid spending more than necessary.

words.ex: He put the books in a box.
words.ex_cn: 他把书放进了一个箱子里。
words.en: A box is a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid.

words.ex: He finally finished his homework.
words.en: You use finally to suggest that something happens after a long period of time, usually later than you wanted or expected.

words.tr:
n. 打印；印刷；
v. 打印；印刷；
words.ex: The print of the photo is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片的打印很清晰。
words.en: To produce text or pictures on paper, usually using a machine called a printer.

words.ex: He wrote his name on the paper.
words.en: A material made from cellulose pulp, derived mainly from wood, rags, and certain grasses, processed into flexible sheets or rolls by deposit from an aqueous suspension, and used chiefly for writing, printing, drawing, wrapping, and covering walls.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.ex: She moved to Australia last year.
words.ex_cn: 她去年搬到了澳大利亚。
words.en: A country comprising the mainland of the Australian continent, the island of Tasmania, and numerous smaller islands.

words.ex: He works for a small company.
words.en: A company is a business organization that makes money by producing or selling goods or services.

words.ex: He often goes to the park after school.
words.en: Many times; frequently.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

words.ex: He uses the internet to find information.
words.ex_cn: 他使用因特网来查找信息。
words.en: The internet is a global system of interconnected computer networks that use the Internet protocol suite (TCP/IP) to link devices worldwide.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr:
n. 火车；列车；列；队；
v. 训练；培训；
words.ex: I took the train to work this morning.
words.ex_cn: 今天早上我坐火车去上班。
words.en: A train is a number of carriages or trucks which are all connected together and which are pulled by an engine along a railway. Train also means to teach someone the skills of a particular job or activity, or to be taught these skills.

words.tr:
n. 旅游；旅行；
v. 旅游；旅行；
words.ex: His travel to Japan was unforgettable.
words.ex_cn: 他去日本的旅游令人难忘。
words.en: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

words.tr:
n. 计划；打算；
v. 计划；打算；
words.ex: He made a plan to visit his grandparents.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个去看望祖父母的计划。
words.en: A plan is a detailed proposal for doing or achieving something.

words.ex: He bought a ticket for the movie.
words.en: A ticket is a small, official piece of paper or card which shows that you have paid to enter a place such as a theatre or a sports ground, or shows that you have paid for a journey.

words.ex: He loves listening to music every night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢每天晚上听音乐。
words.en: Music is the pattern of sounds produced by people singing or playing instruments.

words.ex: He watches a movie every Friday night.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五晚上都看电影。
words.en: A movie is a story or event recorded by a camera as a set of moving images and shown in a cinema or on television.

words.ex: The stars are bright at night.
words.en: The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: He sends an email every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上发一封电子邮件。
words.en: Email is a system for sending messages from one computer to another via the Internet.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.ex: The children are playing a game in the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在公园里玩游戏。
words.en: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

words.ex: I sometimes walk to school.
words.en: At times; occasionally.

words.ex: We went to the cinema last night.
words.en: A cinema is a place where people go to watch films. It can also refer to the art and industry of making films.

words.ex: He hangs his clothes on the line to dry.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服挂在绳子上晾干。
words.en: Clothes are the things that people wear, such as shirts, coats, trousers, and dresses.

words.tr:
v. 参观；访问；
n. 参观；访问；
words.ex: We visit the museum on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我们在周末参观博物馆。
words.en: To go to a place in order to look at it, or to a person in order to spend time with them.

words.ex: We went to the beach during the holiday.
words.en: A holiday is a day of festivity or recreation when no work is done.

words.ex: I used my card to pay for the groceries.
words.ex_cn: 我用我的银行卡支付了杂货费用。
words.en: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed, or a small rectangular piece of plastic containing personal data in a machine-readable form.

words.ex: We had a small party last Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 我们上个星期六举办了一个小型聚会。
words.en: A party is a social gathering of invited guests, typically involving eating, drinking, and entertainment.

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He would help you if he could.
words.ex_cn: 如果他能的话，他会帮你。
words.en: Used to indicate a hypothetical situation or a future event that was considered likely or planned in the past.

words.ex: He always eats breakfast at 7 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他总是在早上七点吃早餐。
words.en: At all times; on all occasions.

words.tr:
adj. 极好的；大的；伟大的；
adv. 很好地；
words.ex: This is a great movie!
words.en: If you describe someone or something as great, you approve of them or admire them.

words.ex: She baked a chocolate cake for her birthday.
words.ex_cn: 她为生日烤了一个巧克力蛋糕。
words.en: A cake is a sweet food made by baking a mixture of flour, eggs, sugar, and fat in an oven. Cakes may be large and cut into slices or small and intended for one person only.

words.ex: He has never been to Japan.
words.en: At no time in the past or future; on no occasion; not ever.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.tr:
v. 切；割；削减；
n. 切；割；削减；
words.ex: He cut the apple with a knife.
words.en: To make an opening, incision, or wound in (something) with a sharp-edged tool or object.

words.ex: She gave me a book.
words.en: To freely transfer the possession of something to someone; to cause or allow someone to have something.

words.ex: She sings a song every morning.
words.en: To produce musical sounds with the voice, especially words with a set tune.

words.ex: The child is happy when he plays with his toys.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子玩玩具时，他很快乐。
words.en: If you are happy, you are feeling or showing pleasure or contentment.

words.tr:
n. 秘密；
adj. 秘密的；
words.ex: He kept the secret from everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他把秘密藏了起来，谁也没告诉。
words.en: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

words.ex: He said something funny, and everyone yelled 'haha'.
words.ex_cn: 他说了件有趣的事，大家都喊‘哈哈’。
words.en: An expression used to indicate laughter or amusement, often in informal communication.

words.tr: abbr. 激光唱片；光盘；“Compact Disc”的缩写
words.ex: I bought a cd of my favorite songs.
words.ex_cn: 我买了一张我最爱歌曲的激光唱片。
words.en: A chemical element (symbol Cd) that is a soft, bluish-white metal, often used in batteries and pigments, and is toxic.

words.tr: n. 音乐会；演奏会；一致；和谐；
words.ex: We went to a concert last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚去听了音乐会。
words.en: A concert is a performance of music by one or more musicians or singers, which usually takes place in the evening.

words.ex: He reads a magazine every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上读一本杂志。
words.en: A magazine is a type of thin book with large pages and a paper cover which contains articles, photographs, and advertisements, usually on a particular subject or aimed at a particular readership.

words.ex: She wore a warm scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条暖和的围巾。
words.en: A scarf is a piece of cloth that you wear around your neck or head, usually to keep yourself warm.

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.tr:
n. 连衣裙；衣服；
v. 穿衣服；
words.ex: She wore a red dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条红色连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A dress is a piece of clothing for women or girls that covers the body and part or all of the legs. To dress means to put clothes on yourself or someone else.

words.ex: He wears a red t-shirt every day.
words.en: A T-shirt is a casual shirt with short sleeves and no collar, typically made of cotton.

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.tr:
n. 锻炼；行使；练习；
v. 运用；使用；锻炼；
words.ex: He does exercise every morning to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上锻炼以保持健康。
words.en: Physical activity that you do to make your body strong and healthy.

words.tr:
v. 穿；戴；
n. 磨损；衣着；
words.ex: He wears a blue shirt every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都穿一件蓝色衬衫。
words.en: If you wear something such as clothes, shoes, or jewellery, you have them on your body or on part of your body.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.ex: He put on his shoe before going out.
words.en: A shoe is a covering for the foot, typically made of leather, having a sturdy sole and not reaching above the ankle.

words.ex: He spends money on books.
words.en: To spend means to use money to buy or pay for something, or to use time or energy in a particular way.

words.ex: I need the money for the bill.
words.ex_cn: 我需要这笔钱来付账单。
words.en: Money is the coins or bank notes that you use to buy things, or the amount of these that you have.

words.tr:
n. 电影；底片；薄薄的一层；
v. 拍摄电影；
words.ex: I watched a funny film last night.
words.ex_cn: 我昨晚看了一部有趣的电影。
words.en: A film is a series of moving pictures, usually shown in a cinema or on television and often telling a story.

words.ex: He sings a happy song every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上唱一首快乐的歌。
words.en: A song is a piece of music with words that is sung.

words.tr:
v. 相配；
n. 比赛；
words.ex: The curtains match the sofa.
words.en: A match is a competition or game in which people or teams compete against each other. It can also refer to a small stick that produces a flame when rubbed against a rough surface, used for lighting a fire, cigarette, etc. Additionally, it can mean a person or thing that is equal to another in quality, strength, or suitability.

words.ex: I will visit you this weekend.
words.en: The weekend is Saturday and Sunday, the two days in the week when many people do not work.

words.ex: He plays football at weekends.
words.en: During the weekend; typically referring to Saturday and Sunday.

words.tr: adj. 亲爱的；昂贵的；宝贵的；
words.ex: Dear friend, I miss you so much.
words.ex_cn: 亲爱的朋友，我非常想念你。
words.en: If someone or something is dear to you, it means you have a lot of affection for them or it is very important to you.

words.ex: I hear birds singing in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 我听到早晨鸟儿在唱歌。
words.en: To perceive or become aware of (sound) through the ear.

words.ex: I haven't heard from my friend for a week.
words.ex_cn: 我一周没有收到我朋友的消息了。
words.en: to receive communication from someone

words.ex: He is afraid of the dark.
words.en: Feeling fear or anxiety; frightened.

words.ex: I can't swim.
words.en: Cannot; used to indicate that something is not possible or allowed.

words.ex: I cannot swim.
words.en: Cannot is the negative form of 'can'. It is used to say that someone is not able to do something or that something is not possible.

words.ex: He sent a postcard from Paris.
words.ex_cn: 他从巴黎寄了一张明信片。
words.en: A postcard is a piece of thick paper or thin cardboard, typically rectangular, intended for writing and mailing without an envelope and at a lower rate than a letter.

words.tr:
v. 叫；打电话；
n. 打电话；
words.ex: He calls his dog every morning.
words.en: If you call someone, you telephone them. If you call someone a particular name or title, you give them that name or title. If you call a meeting, you arrange for it to take place. If you call for something, you demand that it should happen.

words.tr:
v. 躺；撒谎；
n. 谎言；
words.ex: The cat lies on the sofa.
words.en: If someone is lying, they are saying something which they know is not true.

words.ex: The sun rises in the east.
words.en: The star around which the earth orbits, providing light and warmth.

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.tr: v. 做（某个动作）；接受；带领；花费；拿；乘坐；
words.ex: He takes a deep breath before speaking.
words.ex_cn: 他在说话前深吸一口气。
words.en: To lay hold of (something) with one's hands; reach for and hold.

words.ex: He takes photos of the sunset every evening.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上拍夕阳的照片。
words.en: To capture images using a camera.

words.tr:
v. 等待；等候；
n. 等待；等候；
words.ex: I wait for the bus every morning.
words.en: to stay in one place or not do something until something else happens, someone arrives, etc.

words.ex: I will wait to eat until you arrive.
words.en: To delay an action until a later time or until a specific condition is met.

words.tr:
v. 行走；
n. 步行；
words.ex: I walk to school every day.
words.en: To move along on foot at a moderate pace; to go on foot for pleasure or exercise.

words.tr:
n. 旅行；旅程；
v. 绊倒；
words.ex: We went on a trip to the mountains last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去山里旅行了。
words.en: A trip is a journey in which you go somewhere, usually for a short time, and come back again.

words.tr:
adj. 很少；不多；
pron. 很少人；一些；
n. 几个；
words.ex: Few people came to the meeting.
words.en: A few means a small number of things or people. When you say there are a few of something, you mean there are not many of them.

words.ex: I have a few apples on the table.
words.en: A small number of things or people.

words.tr: n. 销售；出售；减价销售；
words.ex: The store has a big sale every winter.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店每年冬天都有大促销。
words.en: The exchange of a commodity for money; the action of selling something.

words.ex: The shoes are on sale this week.
words.en: If products in a shop are on sale, they can be bought for less than their normal price.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.tr: adv. 不管怎样；无论如何；
words.ex: I don't like the weather, but anyway, we will go for a walk.
words.ex_cn: 我不喜欢这天气，但不管怎样，我们会去散步。
words.en: You use anyway or anyhow to indicate that a statement explains or supports a previous point.

words.tr:
adv. 回原处；向后；
n. 后面；背部；
v. 支持；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: He put the book back on the shelf.
words.en: The back is the rear surface of the human body from the shoulders to the hips.

words.ex: He will go back to his hometown next week.
words.en: To return to a place or situation that you were in before.

words.tr:
v. 驾驶；驱使；
n. 动力；
words.ex: He drives a car to work every day.
words.en: To operate and control the direction and speed of a motor vehicle; to push, propel, or carry along forcibly or strongly.

words.tr:
adv. 离；断开；
prep. 离开；脱落；
adj. 空闲的；远离的；
int. 走开；
words.ex: The boat moved off from the shore.
words.en: If something is off, it is not on or is not being used.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

words.tr: phrase. 热狗（面包夹熏红肠）
words.ex: He eats a hot dog at the park.
words.en: A hot dog is a cooked sausage, traditionally grilled or steamed and served in a sliced bun as a sandwich.

words.tr:
v. 离开；离去；留下；
n. 休假；
words.ex: He will leave the room after class.
words.en: To go away from a place or a person.

words.ex: We ate dinner at a small restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我们在一家小餐厅吃了晚饭。
words.en: A restaurant is a place where you can eat a meal and pay for it. In restaurants, your food is usually served to you at your table by a waiter or waitress.

words.ex: He waited for a moment before speaking.
words.en: A moment is a very short period of time.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: This thing is very useful.
words.en: An object, fact, affair, circumstance, or concept considered as being a separate entity.

words.tr:
adv. 最；
pron. 大部分；
adj. 最多的；大多数的；
words.ex: He is most tired after work.
words.en: You use most to refer to the majority of a group of things or people or the largest part of something.

words.tr:
adv. 仍然；还是；
adj. 静止的；
words.ex: He is still waiting for the bus.
words.en: If a situation that used to exist still exists, it has continued and exists now.

words.ex: The star shines brightly in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 这颗星星在夜空中明亮地闪耀。
words.en: A star is a large ball of burning gas in space that you can see as a point of light in the sky at night.

words.tr:
v. 经营；跑步；
n. 运转；跑；
words.ex: He runs a small coffee shop.
words.en: To move quickly on foot so that both feet leave the ground during each stride.

words.tr:
n. 学习；研究；书房；
v. 学习；研究；
words.ex: His study of biology took five years.
words.ex_cn: 他对生物学的学习持续了五年。
words.en: The activity of learning or gaining knowledge, especially from books, or a detailed investigation and analysis of a subject or situation.

words.ex: The children carried paper lanterns at the festival.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在节日上提着纸灯笼。
words.en: A lantern is a lamp in a container that has a handle for holding or hanging it, and it usually has a protective case around the flame or bulb.

words.ex: The boy drew a big dragon on his notebook.
words.ex_cn: 男孩在他的笔记本上画了一条大龙。
words.en: A mythical monster like a giant reptile. In European tradition, it is typically fire-breathing and tends to symbolize chaos or evil, whereas in East Asia it is usually a beneficent symbol of fertility, associated with water and the heavens.

words.tr:
n. 舞蹈；
v. 跳舞；
words.ex: She loves to watch the traditional dance.
words.en: To move your body rhythmically to music, typically following a set sequence of steps.

words.tr:
adj. 洁净的；干净的；
v. 打扫；使干净；
words.ex: The kitchen is clean after she wiped the counters.
words.ex_cn: 她擦了台面后，厨房变得洁净了。
words.en: If something is clean, it is free from dirt, marks, or unwanted substances.

words.ex: She sweeps the floor every morning.
words.en: To clean an area by brushing away dirt or litter.

words.ex: My room is on the third floor.
words.en: The floor is the surface of a room on which you stand.

words.ex: The cooks prepare dinner every evening.
words.ex_cn: 厨师们每天晚上准备晚餐。
words.en: To prepare food by heating it, often by boiling, baking, or frying. Also refers to a person who prepares and cooks food, especially as a job.

words.ex: We had a quick meal at noon.
words.ex_cn: 我们在中午吃了一顿简单的饭。
words.en: A meal is an occasion when people sit down to eat food, especially breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

words.ex: He speaks English every day.
words.en: To say words in order to express thoughts, feelings, or opinions.

words.ex: The accident happened yesterday.
words.en: If something happens, it occurs as a result of a situation or course of action.

words.ex: I am ready for the test.
words.en: If you are ready, you are prepared for something or are in a suitable state to do or deal with it.

words.ex: He is getting ready for school.
words.en: To prepare oneself for something that is going to happen.

words.ex: The town holds a music festival every summer.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇每年夏天都举办音乐节。
words.en: A festival is an organized series of events such as musical concerts or drama productions, often happening annually in the same place.

words.ex: It is quite cold today.
words.en: To a certain or fairly significant extent or degree; fairly.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.ex: She is a beautiful girl.
words.en: Pleasing the senses or mind aesthetically.

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.ex: He walked away from the house.
words.en: If someone or something moves or is moved away from a place, they move or are moved so that they are no longer there.

words.tr: phrase. 收起来；杀死；关进监狱；放弃
words.ex: He put away his toys after playing.
words.ex_cn: 他玩完后把玩具收起来了。
words.en: To put something away means to place it in its proper storage location, to save or store it, to consume it, or to confine someone in prison.

words.tr:
adj. 困难的；坚硬的；费劲的；
adv. 努力地；
words.ex: This math problem is hard.
words.en: If something is hard, it is very difficult to do or deal with. It can also mean that something is solid and firm, not soft or liquid.

words.ex: He wants to join the football team.
words.en: To become a member of a group or organization; to connect or fasten things together.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.ex: Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则我们会错过公交车。
words.en: If you tell someone to hurry up, you are telling them to do something more quickly than they were doing it.

words.ex: We buy gifts for Christmas.
words.en: Christmas is the period around the 25th of December when Christians celebrate the birth of Jesus Christ.

words.ex: My birthday is in February.
words.en: February is the second month of the year in the Julian and Gregorian calendars.

words.ex: He was born in January.
words.en: January is the first month of the year in the Gregorian calendar.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.tr: phrase. 扫除；清除；彻底消除
words.ex: The heavy rain may sweep away the small bridge.
words.ex_cn: 大雨可能会冲走这座小桥。
words.en: To remove or eliminate completely and suddenly.

words.ex: He won the lottery by pure luck.
words.ex_cn: 他纯粹是靠运气中了彩票。
words.en: Luck is the force that causes things, especially good things, to happen to you by chance and not as a result of your own efforts or abilities.

words.tr:
n. 桌子；表格；台子；
v. 搁置；
words.ex: He put his books on the table.
words.en: A table is a piece of furniture with a flat top that you put things on or use to do things such as eat, write, or work.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.ex: He wears traditional clothes on holidays.
words.ex_cn: 他在节日时穿传统服装。
words.en: Traditional refers to customs, beliefs, or methods that have existed for a long time without changing.

words.ex: She made dumplings for dinner.
words.en: A small lump of dough that is cooked and served with a meal, often as a side dish.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: He wears a warm sweater in winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天穿一件暖和的毛衣。
words.en: A sweater is a piece of clothing that you wear on the upper part of your body. It is usually made of wool or cotton and has long sleeves.

words.tr:
n. 外衣；大衣；
v. 覆盖；
words.ex: He put on his coat before going out.
words.en: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: He is lucky to win the prize.
words.en: If you describe someone or something as lucky, you mean that they have something which is very desirable or that they are in a very desirable situation.

words.ex: The children are merry on Christmas day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节那天很开心。
words.en: If you describe someone's character or behavior as merry, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.ex: They say merry Christmas to their family on December 25.
words.ex_cn: 他们在12月25日对家人说圣诞快乐。
words.en: A greeting said to someone at Christmas to wish them a happy time.

words.ex: He told me the news.
words.en: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

words.ex: I think it is a good idea.
words.en: To have a particular opinion, belief, or idea about someone or something.
